title: Review source decisions
mode: Review first: wait for my decision before paid or reward-eligible reads
modeNotice: Requires your authenticated funded browser session. Each live review expires after 60 seconds. Agreement admits this read within your existing cap; it does not sign a payment.
signedOut: Sign in with the original report owner to review its decisions.
ownerChanged: The signed-in owner changed. This run's private reviews are hidden.
empty: No captured decision reviews are available for this owner and report. Older decisions are not reconstructed.
failed: Review could not be confirmed. Check the recorded state before trying again.
saved: Your decision was recorded. An opinion does not reverse or refund a payment.
waiting: Waiting for your decision. No payment for this read has started.
closed: This live review is closed. A later opinion cannot restart the research.
opinionChanged: The displayed code snapshot changed. An earlier opinion may remain recorded. Review this state before recording another opinion.
gateBasis: Gate vote on the initial offered code snapshot and terms: {action} ({rule}).
opinionBasis: Later opinion on the code snapshot displayed when voted: {action} ({rule}).
heldNotice: Cache and creator-free reads can earn citation rewards, so they also need review. Declining, waiting and expiry are not code refusals.
terms: Access proposal: {price} micro-USDC · list ceiling {listPrice} · citation pool cap {reward} micro-USDC · {network}
identity: Reviews use the authenticated wallet identity. This is not proof of a unique human or factual correctness. Reasons stay private.
metricsNotice: New captured decisions only. The rate uses the latest recorded verdict per decision. Gate votes concern the initial offered code and terms; later opinions concern the code snapshot shown when voted. A later code change does not rewrite that vote. These counts do not prove useful research, factual accuracy or payment settlement. No verdicts means no agreement rate. Holds, declines and expiry do not count as code refusals; old decisions are not reconstructed.
metricsCohorts: Outside requires a trusted classification. Team and scripted activity are separate; all unclassified identities remain unknown. A wallet does not prove a unique human. Reasons and reviewer identities stay private. Dates use UTC, with the end day excluded.
metricsCaption: Captured owner decisions and latest opinions in the selected complete UTC days.
metricsUnavailable: Decision counts are unavailable. No zero or agreement rate is inferred.
invalidPeriod: Choose complete past UTC days within one year, with the end after the start.
